Usage: provenance init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --path <PATH>
          [default: .]
      --quiet
          Drop the advisory notes commands print alongside their output, such as the warning that this repository has no shaping skills installed
      --scope <SCOPE>
          
      --path-prefix <PATH_PREFIX>
          
      --disposition-actor-id <DISPOSITION_ACTOR_ID>
          Repository-local actor ID allowed to attest proposal dispositions. Repeat for multiple actors. On re-init, omission preserves the allowlist
      --clear-disposition-actors
          Empty the repository-local disposition actor allowlist
      --ste-pdf <STE_PDF>
          Import this local Issue 9 dictionary PDF instead of downloading the official asset
  -h, --help
          Print help
